name: Maternal Uniparental Disomy of Chromosome 21 Syndrome

criteria.description: Molecular genetic confirmation of maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 21 by microsatellite analysis or SNP array
Presence of developmental delay or intellectual disability without typical trisomy 21 features
Lack of classic Down syndrome phenotypic features despite chromosome 21 involvement

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Molecular genetic confirmation of maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 21 plus presence of developmental delay or intellectual disability
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of trisomy 21 mosaicism and paternal uniparental disomy.

laboratory: Molecular genetic testing showing maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 21
imaging: Brain MRI may show nonspecific delayed myelination
Echocardiogram to evaluate for congenital heart defects
genetic: Microsatellite or SNP array analysis confirming maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 21
other: Audiological evaluation for recurrent otitis media complications

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of typical trisomy 21 facial features
Full or mosaic trisomy 21 on karyotype
Higher prevalence of congenital heart defects
Paternal origin of both chromosome 21 copies

redFlags: Severe developmental delay without typical trisomy 21 features
Confirmed maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 21 by genetic testing
Presence of congenital anomalies inconsistent with classic Down syndrome
references: Orphanet: Maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 21 syndrome, ORPHA:96187
Robinson WP, et al. Uniparental disomy: origin, mechanisms and clinical consequences. Am J Med Genet. 2000.
Molecular diagnosis of uniparental disomy: implications for clinical practice. Hum Genet. 2012.
